title: Digital Objects: What, Why, and How
description:
Digital Objects are a new Ethereum-based software construct enabled by recent advancements in recursive ZKPs and Ethereum DA that 0xPARC has been productionalizing as of this year. 

Digital Objects unlock a large class of valuable applications on Ethereum that we are actively working with partners to develop pilots for. We believe that the deployment of Digital Objects will significantly broaden Ethereum's audience and use cases, and are seeking to reach Ethereum developers to help us build such applications.

Technologically, DOs represent a novel use of Ethereum as a highly scalable "public broadcast channel", with computation offloaded to individual end-users rather than the Ethereum network itself. Understanding this architecture pattern may benefit developers who are also seeking ways to build scalable applications using Ethereum as a public billboard.
